thread:
ana: Heads-up: short-response p95 spiked after the short-seq kernel flip. Profiling shows host parse + streaming is now the dominant tail.
mike: can you share the sampled hotspots?
mana: paste:
```
flame: ingress.parse -> pretokenize.utf8_check -> frame_writer.flush_small -> grpc_write_small -> epoll_wait
hotspots: frame_writer.flush_small (40%), utf8_check (20%), grpc_write_small (12%)
```
devon: that flush_small is creating a syscall per chunk. Kernel speedup unmasked host syscall costs.
sam: two low-risk fixes: (1) host-side mini-aggregator that groups small frames into a single write (size/count/timeout knobs), (2) utf8 quick-path to skip full normalize on already-normalized inputs.
mike: microbench results?
sam: with agg(max_chunks=3,max_bytes=4096,timeout_ms=5) + utf8_quickpath: p95 for <=64-token streams down ~25%. write syscalls per-request -4x. proxy CPU +5%.
devon: KV caveat: delaying flush can increase serialization on kv-shard leaders for heavy multi-chunk miss flows. Need bypass rules.
mana: propose bypass if chunk_count>8 OR (kv_miss && chunk_count>5). Also add per-tenant opt-out.
mike: telemetry please: histograms host.preproc.normalize_ms, counters host.streamer.writev_count, tags for agg_bypass_reason.
ops-bot: deploy streamer-miniagg-canary -> intake-1 (5%)
ops-bot: rollout started
devon: initial 10m snapshot: canary p95 -20% vs baseline, writev_count -3.7x, normalize_ms median 0.07ms. One heavy tenant saw +6% kv latency.
sam: tightened kv bypass for kv_miss to chunk_count>4 and added per-tenant opt-out, rolled to 15%. Heavy tenant metrics back to baseline; overall p95 -18%.
mike: sounds good. PR should include microbench scripts, flame captures, config flags: host.streamer.agg_bytes, host.streamer.agg_chunks, host.streamer.agg_timeout_ms, host.preproc.utf8_quickcheck, host.streamer.kv_bypass_threshold. Also include kernel-selection note: short-seq kernels must be validated end-to-end with host batching knobs.
nana: scheduling 20m follow-up tomorrow to pick defaults and launch prod rollout. labels: perf, host-parse, grpc, kvcache.
